name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4

name: country_id
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the reference economy
observations: One row per individual economy; the BIS reference-area aggregates are excluded

name: reference_area_code
description: BIS reference area code as published
observations: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code retained verbatim from the BIS series key

name: reference_area_name
description: Name of the reference economy or aggregate

name: value_type
description: Whether the series is nominal or real (deflated by consumer prices)

name: measure
observations: index for the price index level, or year-on-year change for the percentage change over the same quarter of the previous year

name: unit
description: Unit of the reported value as published by the BIS
observations: Index rows are on the common 2010 = 100 base; year-on-year change rows are in per cent

name: bis_series_key
observations: Dot-separated FREQ.REF_AREA.VALUE.UNIT_MEASURE codes, for example Q.AU.N.628; traces each row back to the BIS Data Portal

name: value
description: Observation value, in the unit given by the unit column
observations: Carries no fixed measurement_unit: a tidy-indicator column whose unit varies by row (index points for index rows, per cent for year-on-year change rows)
